Warranty Information Smooth. Warm. Musical. This Pyrex glass slide delivers a vocal, singing sustain with warm mids and smooth, rounded highs that glide across the strings. True Pyrex Smoothness Dense Pyrex glass boosts sustain and keeps your tone warm and even, with a perfectly consistent surface that glides without drag. Made for Amplified Tone Compatible with any guitar, but ideal on electrics where the dense glass adds sustain and softens high frequencies that often make metal slides sound too sharp through pickups. Made in the USA Every glass slide is crafted at our Benicia, California factory for consistent quality, flawless finish, and dependable performance you can feel.
